title: Cadillac reveals name of first F1 car, honoring American racing legend Mario Andretti
content:
Cadillac has revealed its car name for its debut Formula 1 season in 2026, honoring American racing legend Mario Andretti.

Cadillac will join F1 as the sport’s 11th team in 2026, marking the first expansion of the grid in a decade as it becomes the second American squad on the grid after Haas.

The team has already put its new car on the track through preseason testing with race drivers Valtteri Bottas and Sergio Pérez, and revealed its livery through an advert in the Super Bowl.

But it was not until Friday that Cadillac finally confirmed its official chassis name for 2026 — the Cadillac MAC-26, which stands for Mario Andretti Cadillac 26.

“Racing has been the joy of my life,” Andretti said in a statement. “It is the ultimate compliment that the Cadillac Formula 1 Team sees those years as meaningful and worthy of recording with this honor.

“I cherish the opportunity that it gives me to have a lasting bond with F1 and am genuinely appreciative of everyone who continues to acknowledge my part in racing history.”

The move honors Andretti, who was the most recent American F1 world champion in 1978, and shows recognition for his role in the formation of the team.

The Cadillac project was initially spearheaded by Andretti’s son, Michael Andretti, who wanted to establish a new F1 team under the Andretti Global name, only for F1 to reject the entry in Jan. 2024.

Michael Andretti stepped back from the F1 project that year, while the team was rebranded as Cadillac in a sign of closer ties with General Motors, prompting the sport to change its mind by the end of 2024 and approve the entry from 2026.

As part of a restructured leadership, Mario Andretti took on a non-executive role on the board of the Cadillac team, as well as serving as a team ambassador.

“Mario Andretti is a legend of Formula 1, a true racer who knows how to win and push the limits of what is possible,” said Graeme Lowdon, Cadillac’s team principal. “But more than that, he is an incredible man with a gentle heart who believes in everyone’s ability to shape their own path.

“At the start of my own journey with the team, he asked me not to let him down. I hope that he will be proud to see the Cadillac Formula 1 Team car bearing his name finally take to the grid.”

The Cadillac MAC-26 will make its official F1 debut at the 2026 season-opening Australian Grand Prix on Mar. 8.
